facts.fact: The Medusa submarine cable (8,700 km, linking Libya to Mediterranean countries) was inaugurated on 10 May 2025 at Misrata, per state holding company LPTIC as reported by Libya Herald; Libya United International Company (LUIC) signed the connection contract in November 2023.

note: Its arrival at Benghazi is announced but the cable is not stated in service.

Medusa shore end installed at Benghazi with the main cable still to lay; no route stated in service.
No route stated in service; MEDUSA is named only as a prospective route.
